edges.reason: Constructor assigns admin from the untrusted caller, establishing the privileged role.
require(msg.sender == admin) gates setting a new pending implementation.
require(msg.sender == pendingImplementation) gates accepting the implementation role.
require(msg.sender == admin) gates setting a new pending admin.
require(msg.sender == pendingAdmin) gates accepting the admin role.
Admin check guards replacement of the management contract.
Admin check guards replacement of the reward strategy contract.
Admin check guards replacement of the reward calculator contract.
Admin check plus staking consistency checks guard the staking address replacement.
require(msg.sender == delegator.admin()) gates the proxy implementation change path.
Claim account is derived directly from the untrusted caller.
claimAll account is derived directly from the untrusted caller.
Transfer source account is derived directly from the untrusted caller.
Repayer is derived from the untrusted caller for the eFIL pull.
accrue returns/updates rewards for the calling account.
addLiqudity pulls eFIL directly from the untrusted caller.
Deposit account and funding source is the untrusted caller.
Withdraw account is the untrusted caller.
Redistributor.claim uses msg.sender as the account owner.
Redistributor.accrue reads accrual state for msg.sender.
Redistributor.claimAll uses msg.sender as the account owner.
Redistributor.transfer uses msg.sender as the source account.
Constructor stores the deployer as admin.
Constructor initializes the eFIL token address.
Constructor initializes the FILST token address.
Writes the caller-supplied address into pendingImplementation, arming a proxy upgrade.
Moves pendingImplementation into the live implementation slot used by delegatecall.
Clears the pending implementation after acceptance.
Writes the caller-supplied address into pendingAdmin.
Promotes pendingAdmin to admin, transferring all privileged rights.
Clears the pending admin slot after acceptance.
Fallback reads the implementation slot as the delegatecall target.
Fallback delegatecalls arbitrary implementation code with msg.data, allowing external execution in proxy storage context.
Fallback forwards raw return data through inline assembly.
accrue obtains the current block number for its freshness check.
accrue reads Staking(staking).totalDeposits() to decide whether accrual is needed.
accrue reads the management contract for the total minted amount.
accrue reads the calculator contract to compute the reward delta.
accrue reads the strategy contract to allocate the reward delta.
accrue performs external calls to management, calculator and strategy before finalizing state.
accrue credits accruedRewards for staking and all allocation recipients.
accrue updates accrualBlockNumber to the current block after processing.
accrue delegates debt index advancement to accureDebtInternal.
accureDebtInternal advances debtAccruedIndex with fixed-point ratio arithmetic.
Uses fraction/add_ fixed-point helpers whose rounding and overflow behavior affect debt index.
accruedStored returns stored accrued rewards when the accrual is fresh or there are no shares.
accruedStored checks Staking(staking).totalDeposits() as a short-circuit condition.
accruedStored queries the management contract for total minted amount.
accruedStored queries the calculator for the pending reward delta.
accruedStored queries the strategy for allocation of the pending delta.
accruedStored sums allocations with overflow-checked add_ arithmetic.
accruedDebtStored delegates per-miner math to accruedDebtStoredInternal.
accruedDebtStored uses debtAccruedIndex as its baseline when the accrual is fresh.
accruedDebtStoredInternal reads the miner's stored Debt struct.
accruedDebtStoredInternal queries the miner's minted amount from management.
Per-miner debt delta is computed with fixed-point index arithmetic.
accrue(string) first calls the global accrue().
accrue(string) then distributes debt for the given miner.
distributeDebtInternal snapshots the miner's debt into storage.
distributeDebtInternal records the current debtAccruedIndex on the miner's Debt.
RewardPool.claim calls accrue() to refresh accounting before paying out.
claim performs the external token transfer through transferRewardOut before decrementing accruedRewards.
claim mutates accruedRewards for the caller after the transfer.
claimAll refreshes accounting through accrue().
claimAll transfers the full balance out before zeroing accruedRewards.
claimAll zeroes the caller's accruedRewards entry after transfer.
transferRewardOut resolves the eFIL token contract from efilAddress.
transferRewardOut performs an external eFIL transfer to the receiver.
repayDebt calls accrue(miner) to keep the miner's debt fresh.
repayDebt reads and decrements the miner's stored debt.
repayDebt pulls eFIL from the token at efilAddress.
repayDebt performs an external eFIL transferFrom pull from the caller.
transfer calls accrue() before moving credited rewards.
transfer debits the sender and credits the recipient in accruedRewards.
setManagement writes the privileged management contract used for reward math.
setManagement initializes debtAccruedIndex when it is zero.
setStrategy writes the privileged strategy contract controlling allocation.
setCalculator writes the privileged calculator contract controlling reward amounts.
setStaking writes the privileged staking address used for share accounting.
setStaking validates the new staking contract's property equals filstAddress.
setStaking validates the new staking contract's asset equals efilAddress.
addLiqudity uses efilAddress for the incoming token transfer.
addLiqudity credits the admin's accruedRewards with the pulled amount.
addLiqudity performs an external eFIL transferFrom from an arbitrary caller.
_become invokes the delegator's implementation acceptance after an admin identity check.
accrueInternal calls superior.accrue() externally before updating accrual state.
accrueInternal advances globalAccruedIndex using ratio-based fixed-point arithmetic.
accrueInternal uses fraction/add_ helpers for the accrued index update.
accrueInternal caches superiorAccruedAmount after a successful accrual.
Redistributor.accrue calls accrueInternal to refresh global state.
Redistributor.accrue computes the instant accrued amount for msg.sender.
Redistributor.claim accrues global state before payout.
Redistributor.claim snapshots the caller's account state before payout.
Redistributor.claim calls superior.claim externally before decrementing accruedAmount, allowing reentrancy into claim/claimAll.
Redistributor.claim decrements the caller's AccountState.accruedAmount after the external call.
claimAll accrues global state before payout.
claimAll distributes the caller's accrued share before payout.
claimAll calls superior.claim externally while the account amount is still non-zero.
Redistributor.transfer accrues before moving credited amounts.
Redistributor.transfer distributes the sender's state before moving amounts.
Redistributor.transfer debits the sender and credits the recipient AccountState.
distributeInternal writes the account's accruedIndex and accruedAmount into accountStates.
distributeInternal uses globalAccruedIndex as the snapshot index.
Redistributor.accruedStored divides the superior delta by totalShares.
Redistributor.accruedStored builds a hypothetical index from the current globalAccruedIndex.
Redistributor.accruedStored delegates to accruedStoredInternal for the per-account amount.
Redistributor.accruedStored reads superior.accruedStored for this contract.
accruedStoredInternal reads the account's AccountState share and accrual fields.
accruedStoredInternal uses sub_/mul_/add_ fixed-point helpers for the delta computation.
deposit accrues global state before registering new shares.
deposit distributes the caller's accrued amount before changing shares.
deposit performs the external token pull through doTransferIn before updating totalShares and shares.
deposit increases totalShares by the actual amount received.
deposit increases the caller's AccountState.share.
withdraw accrues global state before releasing shares.
withdraw distributes the caller's accrued amount before payout.
withdraw calls the external token transfer through doTransferOut after updating state, but the underlying token is untrusted.
withdraw decreases totalShares by the withdrawn amount.
withdraw decreases the caller's AccountState.share.

doTransferOut casts the property token address for the outgoing transfer.
doTransferOut performs an external token transfer whose return data is inspected with assembly.
